finding.claim: The scripted checks that produced iteration 1's 4/4 (type folder, index entry, kmctl check, no stray page) live only in a session scratchpad grade.py; evals.json holds prompts and prose expected_output but no expectations, so the grading cannot be rerun from what is kept beside the skill.

fixes.change: Each prompt now lists its expectations, the scripted checks plus the judged type fit and, for the tutorial, no guessed install command.
The grading script is kept beside the skill, takes the iteration folder as its argument and finds kmctl on PATH or KMCTL_BIN.
Names evals.json's expectations and grade.py as the source of the 4/4 scores.
